name: Advanced Button for Block Editor
author: bdthemes

sections.description:
Advanced Button Block for WordPress Editor – Create Stylish, Customizable Buttons with Ease

The Advanced Button Block is a powerful and intuitive WordPress block editor plugin designed to help you create visually stunning, highly customizable buttons for your website. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced developer, this plugin empowers you to design buttons that perfectly match your site’s aesthetic and functionality.

With the Advanced Button Block, you can effortlessly craft buttons that stand out, thanks to its wide range of pre-made styles, layout controls, and integrated icons. This plugin is perfect for adding call-to-action buttons, navigation buttons, or any other interactive elements to your posts, pages, or custom templates.

Key Features:

  • Customizable Button Designs: Choose from a variety of pre-designed button styles or create your own unique designs with advanced customization options.

  • Layout Controls: Easily adjust button alignment, spacing, and sizing to fit seamlessly into your content layout.

  • Icon Integration: Enhance your buttons with built-in icons or upload your own to make them more engaging and visually appealing.

  • Responsive Design: Ensure your buttons look great on all devices with fully responsive design options.

  • Hover Effects: Add interactive hover effects to make your buttons more dynamic and user-friendly.

  • Typography Controls: Customize button text with advanced typography settings, including font size, weight, and color.

  • Gradient and Background Options: Create eye-catching buttons with gradient backgrounds or solid colors.

  • Border and Shadow Settings: Fine-tune the appearance of your buttons with customizable borders and shadow effects.

  • SEO-Friendly: Optimized for search engines to help improve your site’s visibility and ranking.

Why Choose Advanced Button Block?

  • User-Friendly Interface: Designed with simplicity in mind, this plugin is easy to use, even for non-technical users.

  • Time-Saving: With pre-made templates and one-click styling options, you can create professional buttons in seconds.

  • Flexible and Extendable: Compatible with most WordPress themes and plugins, ensuring seamless integration into your existing setup.

  • Regular Updates: Stay ahead with frequent updates that bring new features, improvements, and compatibility with the latest WordPress versions.

Perfect For:

  • Call-to-Action Buttons: Drive conversions with buttons that grab attention and encourage clicks.

  • Navigation Buttons: Improve user experience with intuitive and visually appealing navigation elements.

  • Social Media Buttons: Add stylish buttons to link to your social media profiles.

  • E-Commerce Sites: Create buttons for product purchases, subscriptions, or other e-commerce actions.
sections.installation:
Plugin Installation Method:

  1. Go to the WordPress dashboard
  2. Got to the Plugins > Add New
  3. Type “Advanced Button” in the search box
  4. Click on “Install” button
  5. After install the plugin Activate the plugin

Installation via Zip file:

  1. Download Advanced Button block plugin zip file from WordPress
  2. Go to site Dashboard > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugins
  3. Select the Advanced Button zip file and proceed to install
  4. Activate Advanced Button.
sections.faq:
How to Use?

  1. Add the Block:

    • Open the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg).
    • Click the “+” button to add a new block and search for “Advanced Button.”
    • Select and add the block to your post or page.

  2. Customize the Button:

    • Text: Click on the button text and type your desired label (e.g., “Learn More”).
    • URL: Add a URL to link the button to a specific page or site.
    • Background Color: Use the color picker in the block settings sidebar to select a background color.
    • Outline Style: Toggle the “Outline” option in the settings to create a border-only button.

  3. Preview Your Button:

    • Use the preview option to see how the button looks on your website.

  4. Save Changes:

    • Save or update your post/page to make the button live on your site.

What features does the plugin offer?

Advanced Button offers a range of features designed to enhance your web design experience. These includes customizable blocks, layouts, patterns, drag-and-drop interface, advanced styling options, flexibility, responsiveness and more.

Does Advanced Button work with all WordPress themes?

Most certainly all WordPress themes are compatible with the Zolo Blocks framework as the plugin is built for maximum compatibility with WordPress itself.

What if I update to the Premium version?

If you upgrade to the pro plugin version, you will unlock more unique features and customizations. Additionally, you will be able to receive personalized support from team BdThemes.

Do I need any page builder like Elementor or Divi to use this plugin?

No, this plugin is built specifically for the Gutenberg editor and eliminates the need for third-party page builders.
